cohort: The participants were 18 pregnant rats (9 exposed to ETU, 9 saline control) and their embryos, studied for anorectal development.
finding: 55 differentially expressed circRNAs were identified in ETU-induced ARMs, with novel_circ_001042 showing the greatest connectivity and relation to ARM-associated signaling pathways.
gest_age: Exposure on gestational day 10 (GD10); hindgut samples collected on GD14, GD15, and GD16
